summary: The official December 2025 notice records the 1 December 2024 API release, first-of-month updates, monthly API-table CSV alternative, and XML/text retirement from 1 May 2026.
The Magda record resolves to the data.gov.au PBS Item Report CKAN package with eight CSV/XLSX/ZIP resources, CC BY 3.0 AU metadata and 1992-2016 YTD coverage.
All eight resources, totalling 743099064 bytes, are signature-validated in ignored storage with path-free SHA-256 receipts. No utilisation-to-price or complete-coverage claim is made.
